# Panic Mode

Panic Mode applies the Panic Room palette from Bear as a high-contrast dark interface. Its recorded description blends elements taken from several other Obsidian themes into one moody look across notes and UI.

![Panic Mode screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-Panic_Mode/HEAD/panic.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Panic Mode"
    author: "bcdavasconcelos"
    repo:   "bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-Panic_Mode"
    slug:   "panic-mode"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/panic-mode"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-Panic_Mode"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-Panic_Mode/HEAD/panic.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply Bear's Panic Room palette for a high-contrast, dark interface. Blend elements from multiple Obsidian themes to produce a cohesive, moody look across notes and UI."
}
```
